modifications: For the explicitly admitted two-lane Q1 graph, use the installed MLX RoPE vector batch-offset interface to rotate Q and K together across both rows. This replaces four lane-local RoPE calls and two concatenations per layer with two vector calls and no concatenation. A separate v5 source-bound profile requires the new vector flag and keeps the v4 32-token profile available as the same-source control. Route receipts count vector Q1 calls per proven ready layer. Ordinary decode and other paged graph shapes retain their existing math.
